description: Fully remodeled 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home located in an established Killeen neighborhood. This move-in ready property features a functional floor plan with updated flooring, modern finishes, and spacious living areas. Major upgrades include a brand-new electrical system and all new windows, offering improved efficiency and peace of mind. The kitchen has been updated and is ready for your personal touch. Outside, enjoy a spacious yard with two storage sheds, providing added room for tools, equipment, or extra storage. Conveniently located near schools, shopping, dining, and Fort Cavazos. Ideal for both owner-occupants and investors.
